name: shadow-runner-android
description: Shadow Runner: Pixel Adventure — a premium 2D cinematic pixel-art action platformer for Android.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:dev: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
